More Injury Problems for Miami's Kyle Stowers
Yesterday <Miami:team#11> designated hitter <Kyle Stowers:player#25956> sustained a setback in his recovery from strained hamstring. The Marlins medical staff told him it would be at least 3 weeks before he will be able to return to action. <Stowers:player#25956> told reporters, "The healing process has gone extremely well. This is just a little hiccup and a little setback." Apparently <Stowers:player#25956> worked a little too hard in a recent workout and caused more damage. His doctors have advised him to do only light exercise and give the injury time to heal.
